role: The on-disk store of one world: writes session.lock, reads and atomically rewrites level.dat (WorldInfo NBT, with level.dat_old and level.dat_new), and reads and writes playerdata/<uuid>.dat. AnvilSaveHandler extends it with the region chunk loader.
scope_reason: File persistence only. The native engine never reads or writes level.dat or player .dat files: it loads WorldInfo state from a snapshot's worldinfo.nbt (produced by the oracle's Snapshot.java from WorldInfo.getNBTTagCompound) and player state from player_server.nbt, and keeps everything else in memory.

members.name: loadWorldInfo
members.note: native equivalent input is the snapshot worldinfo.nbt parsed in csrc/engine/snapshot.c

notes: Grep of native for SaveHandler, level.dat, session.lock, playerdata and the method names found only comments about level.dat's spawn point in csrc/tests/test_seedworld.c. Not verified: how a play-reload recording (play-reload-s1) is replayed natively; if a later milestone needs the native engine to save and reload a world from disk, this file becomes in scope. initializationTime (session.lock's contents) is netherite.oracle.Oracle.saveClockMillis() (the save clock pin, lane/rerecaudit); checkSessionLock compares the file with the same field, so the lock still works within a run.
